subject.title: fix(discord): preserve gateway messages across dispatch crashes

question: Should the Discord provider adopt the shared durable-ingress drain on its gateway receive path after real crash/restart replay proof confirms exactly-once terminal handling?
rationale: This is a protected maintainer-labeled message-delivery change whose correctness depends on intended lifecycle and gateway-throughput semantics, not only unit coverage.

options.title: Require live recovery proof, then approve
options.body: Capture a redacted receive → forced gateway/process interruption → restart → single recovered dispatch scenario, then review the gateway admission tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the modeled contract evidence
options.body: Approve based on the drain contract tests and code review while explicitly accepting that no live Discord recovery artifact is attached.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof, then approve
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted receive → forced gateway/process interruption → restart → single recovered dispatch scenario, then review the gateway admission tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The related issue defines the cross-channel durable-ingress design and identifies Discord as one of its intended adapter migrations.
